list.title: Vhafhaṱi na Phurojeke
list.hint: Vhafhaṱi vha dzhena kha portal ya vhafhaṱi u itela u ṱanganedza u rumelwa ha phurojeke dzavho na u khwaṱhisedza u buka.
list.empty: A hu athu vha na vhafhaṱi.

detail.deactivateHint: U dzima zwi ita uri mushumisi muṅwe na muṅwe wa mufhaṱi uyu a bve nga u ṱavhanya.
detail.resetPrompt: Phasiwede ntswa ya {{name}} (maḽeḓere a ṱoḓaho u vha 8). Vha ḓo saina fhethu hoṱhe.
detail.projectsHint: Vhafarisani vha nanga kha phurojeke dzi shumaho musi vha tshi ṅwalisa murangaphanḓa; referral i ya kha mufhaṱi uyu.
detail.noProjects: Ahuna dzi project dzine dza kha di vha hone.

protection.placeholder: Maḓuvha a tsireledzo (a si na tshithu = mvelele ya ḽifhasi)
protection.saved: Tsireledzo ya u dovholola yo khwiniswa ya {{name}} .
protection.hint: Tsireledzo ya u dovholola: maḓuvha a 1-3650, kana u sia hu si na tshithu u itela u shumisa mvelele ya ḽifhasi u bva kha Zwiṱirathedzhi. Tshanduko i shuma kha nḓivhadzo ntswa fhedzi - dzine dza vha hone dzi vhulunga tshifhinga tshadzo tsha u fhela.

matching.saved: U ṱanganya ho doweleaho ho khwiniswa ha {{name}}
matching.hint: Ndi zwidodombedzwa zwifhio zwine zwa ita uri u ṅwaliswa huvhili hu vhe khasiṱama nthihi ya phurojeke. Tshanduko dzi shuma kha ṱhoḓisiso dzo dovhololwaho u bva zwino; tsireledzo ine ya vha hone a i kwamei.
